text: The EQC Operational Policy Review (OPR) is an initiative by Toka Tū Ake EQC to overhaul and codify its operational policies following the Public Inquiry into EQC. The review focuses on strengthening EQC’s operational policies and procedures across claims handling, customer conduct, insurer interface, and land/building assessment. It aligns with the recommendations of the Public Inquiry into EQC and the government's modernization of the EQC Act, with independent assurance provided by KPMG.
